chunks: We sent many apostles before you, and bestowed on them wives and children, but it was not for any apostle to come up with a miracle unless by the leave of God. For every age there is a law.
ai.seo_question: Why did God give prophets wives and children if they were chosen messengers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the 'humanity of the prophets' (Insaniyyat al-Anbiya), affirming that their divine status did not strip them of natural human attributes like marriage and progeny, thereby validating their role as relatable guides. It further clarifies that miracles (Ayat) were contingent upon divine decree rather than the prophet's own power, reinforcing the concept of 'Ajal' (appointed term) for each messenger's mission.
